question: In zod 4, what does the `z.treeifyError` function produce from a ZodError, how does that differ from `z.flattenError`, and in which source file are both defined?
critical_facts: explains treeifyError produces a nested, tree-shaped structure that mirrors the schema/data shape, with per-path `errors` and recursive `properties`/`items`
explains flattenError produces a flat structure — `formErrors` plus `fieldErrors` keyed one level deep by the first path segment
names packages/zod/src/v4/core/errors.ts as the file defining both functions
material_errors: describes treeifyError as returning a flat list of issues
cites the legacy v3 error formatting (ZodError.format in v3/types.ts) as the zod 4 answer
evidence: packages/zod/src/v4/core/errors.ts:345 — `export function treeifyError`; return type `$ZodErrorTree` has `errors` + nested `properties`/`items`
packages/zod/src/v4/core/errors.ts:263 — `export function flattenError`; returns `{ formErrors, fieldErrors }`
